title: Order reported lifecycle disposals by the local parent chain so a refused same-root move can't abort the import
outcome: Order reported lifecycle disposals by the local parent chain so a refused same-root move can't abort the import
acceptance: A behavioural regression test reproduces Codex's case: held R→A→P→M→C with M completed and C optional and open; the folder moves M under R (refused) and cancels P and C, with P's UUID sorting before C's. The import completes with C then P cancelled, or refuses only the affected task by name, instead of aborting with 'reported disposal lost admission'
Reported completions and disposals are applied in the order of the admitted local hierarchy, as folder removals are
A behaviour test supersedes onto a replacement this store already holds ended (cancelled locally first): the supersession is Applied, verify_all is healthy and the export equals the resolved tree
